To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

employee empowerment is positively influenced by sharing information, job redesign, transformational leadership style and decision making authority, while continuous training and self-managed teams have no effect on employee empowerment in Jordanian commercial banks.
the most important factors in implementing an employee empowerment initiative are sharing information, job redesign, transformational leadership style, and decision making authority.
sharing information, transformational leadership style, decision making authority and job design are important in empowering employees in the Jordanian banking industry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the factors that influence employee empowerment in the banking industry.
the factors that influence the implementation of empowerment in a Jordanian context.
the factors that affect the implementation of an employee empowerment initiative.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Jordanian banks have a long way to go to empower their employees, but the study findings would certainly provide them with a clear picture of the main influential factors that need to be addressed to achieve a successful empowerment initiative.

the six major determinants of successful employee empowerment are: job design, decision making authority (delegation of authority and decision making power), sharing information, transformational leadership (leaders' ability to empower employees), continuous training and development and self-managed teams.
the more the organization adopts the six factors, the more the employees would be empowered.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the more the employees are empowered, the better they are able to meet the customer needs and thus the more the customer satisfaction is enhanced.
the more the organization provides its employees with the right job design, the more they will be empowered.

empowering employees in a high service sector such as the Jordanian banking industry would be more successful in an organization with the appropriate job design, transformation leadership style, and sharing information.
The main takeaway from our work is that
employee empowerment is a multidimensional construct that is influenced by many variables.
employee empowerment should be implemented as part of a broader organizational strategy and should not be seen in isolation.
empowering employees should become a strategic initiative in the Jordanian banking sector.
